title: SonicWall warns of unpatched vulnerabilities in end-of-life management software
summary: In a report by Bleeping Computer, SonicWall has issued a warning regarding two critical security vulnerabilities affecting its Global Management System, or GMS, which has reached its end-of-life status.
why_it_matters: Exploit-ready vulnerabilities can rapidly translate into compromise—especially for internet-facing services and widely deployed products.
recommendation: Prioritize patching/mitigations, review exposure, and add detection for exploitation attempts (e.g., WAF/EDR signatures and logs).
